IEEE-754 float and double bit conversion, packing, and classification helpers.

# Purpose
This header file defines helper functions for working with IEEE-754 floating-point bit patterns in `float` and, when `FD_HAS_DOUBLE` is enabled, `double`. It provides conversion functions between numeric values and their raw bit representations, plus accessors for the sign, biased exponent, and mantissa fields. It also includes classification functions such as [`fd_fltbits_is_zero`](<#fd_fltbits_is_zero>), [`fd_fltbits_is_denorm`](<#fd_fltbits_is_denorm>), [`fd_fltbits_is_inf`](<#fd_fltbits_is_inf>), [`fd_fltbits_is_nan`](<#fd_fltbits_is_nan>), and the matching double-precision forms, so code can test floating-point values by bit pattern with stable results. The file is a small utility header that supports low-level floating-point inspection and construction without relying on standard classification macros.
